verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is an accounting SaaS, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The only MCP evidence is a forward-looking roadmap statement ('Soon... an MCP layer will let AI agents handle bookkeeping'), not a shipped, connectable server. The built-in Command assistant is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
